title: data-objectstack: ConnectionError stamps 503 on a connect or request that got no answer, so a dropped connection reads as an answered server error
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a (named producer), from #29885 (PR #29915; os-dev report `/mnt/project-files/issue-29885/os-dev-report.md`, PR comment 6602798758). Filed by `domain:ui#3`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** When the Console cannot reach the server at all (dropped connection, unreachable host), some failures still read as if the server had answered with a 503. A reader that trusts a numeric status (`answeredLoadFailure`) then shows "Connection error: Failed to fetch" as the server's own sentence, instead of telling the person to check their connection. #29885 (PR #29915) fixed the same defect for `createErrorFromResponse`'s invented `500`. This is the remaining producer.

**Where it is** (read at PR #29915's head `8923ea28`):
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/errors.ts`: the `ConnectionError` constructor stamps `statusCode || 503` when no status is passed.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`: `connect()`'s catch (~line 3634) and `noteServerUnanswered` (~line 3789) build `new ConnectionError(message, undefined, { originalError })` with no status on paths where nothing answered.
- `connectRetriesDiscovery-12318.test` pins `statusCode` 503 on that path, so the change moves a pin and touches callers. That is why #29885 left it alone.

**Wanted.** A `ConnectionError` built on a no-answer path carries no `statusCode`, so `answeredLoadFailure` returns `null` and `classifyLoadError` reads `network`. An answered 503 still reads as answered. Whether the default moves in the constructor or the two callers pass an explicit "no answer" is for the reader to decide.

**Tests.**
- The real adapter's `connect()` and a request that trips `noteServerUnanswered` over a rejecting `fetch`: no `statusCode`, `answeredLoadFailure` null.
- CONTROL: an answered 503 keeps `statusCode` 503 and reads as answered.
- The 12318 pin moves (named in the PR).
- The ablation goes red.

Dedupe: `is:issue ConnectionError 503`, `is:issue noteServerUnanswered`, `is:issue connection error 503 default dropped` (only #29885).

Links back: #29885, PR #29915, #29728.
